# Libraries and fonts used by My Notes

Copies of free libraries and fonts, kept here so the app works without internet. They are not changed.

| Folder / file | What | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pdfjs/` | PDF.js: reads PDF files | 3.11.174 | [cdnjs](https://cdnjs.com/libraries/pdf.js), [mozilla.github.io/pdf.js](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/) | [Apache License 2.0](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/LICENSE) |
| `html2canvas.min.js` | html2canvas: pictures of pages for sharing | 1.4.1 | [cdnjs](https://cdnjs.com/libraries/html2canvas), [html2canvas.hertzen.com](https://html2canvas.hertzen.com/) | [MIT](https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas/blob/master/LICENSE) |
| `tabler/` | Tabler Icons webfont (only the woff2 font) | 3.19.0 | [jsDelivr](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/icons-webfont@3.19.0/), [tabler.io/icons](https://tabler.io/icons) | [MIT](https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| `fonts/` | Caveat and Comfortaa (Cyrillic and Latin) | Google Fonts | [Caveat](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Caveat), [Comfortaa](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Comfortaa) | [SIL Open Font License 1.1](https://openfontlicense.org/) |
